title: Do You Redo Mercor's Interview for Every Job? #Shorts
description:
Each unique interview only needs to be completed once. Another application asks for the same one, your existing result carries over. It is a gate you cross once, not a toll you pay per job.

Full breakdown of how Mercor works: https://youtu.be/Dd5UFR0pfvg
Source: talent.docs.mercor.com/how-to/assessments

Nothing here is a guarantee of work, acceptance, or income.

#Mercor #AITrainingJobs #RemoteWork
